note: Verified UK retailer policy changes. Ids name the CHANGE, not the date, so a correction to an entry replaces it rather than appearing twice. Served from this app's own origin — the download is of ALL changes, never a query naming the shops a particular person holds, because that query would be the leak the privacy notice rules out.

updates.text: Free postal returns ended — £1.95 unless you drop off in store. Window still 30 days from dispatch.
updates.affectNote: drop off in store to keep it free

updates.text: New 28-day window for “frequent returners” (was 45). Kept flags if that’s you before you buy.
updates.affectNote: your window is the shorter one

updates.text: 14-day window confirmed for the iPhone 18 line. Warranty clocks added automatically.
Price-match refund window extended to 14 days — if it drops in price after you buy, claim the difference.
updates.affectNote: you can claim the difference if the price drops

updates.text: Online orders can no longer be refunded in store — postal returns only. In-store purchases are unaffected.
updates.affectNote: an online order has to go back by post
